title: Hold: no words
notices: A CSV going to Jay with no message.

recorded.text: Hold on. You're sending Jay a file with no words.
Tell him what it is, and what you need from him.

new.text: Hold on. Jay opens this file with no words.
What will he think you need? Say it in one line.

lines.text: Because a file with no words makes Jay guess.
One line on what it is and what you need, and he answers in one reply.

lines: Here is the September lead export I am testing on.
Is September the right month to test with?

then: He adds the line. Jay: "Yes, September is the right month. Good question."
